title: Gas Bundle Courtesy in Residential Electricity Supply Off-Peak Disputes
content:
**Rule.** When a Beacon Ridge gas agreement under Residential Natural Gas Supply on the same premise as the disputed Residential Electricity Supply agreement is active on a fixed-rate gas plan, the fixed-bundle dispute courtesy of 5.00 USD is added to the disputed amount; when it is active on a gas plan that is not fixed-rate, the other-bundle dispute courtesy of 3.00 USD is added; when no gas agreement on the premise is active, nothing is added.

**Records read.** The status of the gas agreement at the same premise and the rate type of its gas plan.

| Gas agreement at the premise | Fixed-rate gas plan | Dispute courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| active | yes | 5.00 USD |
| active | no | 3.00 USD |
| not active (enrollment pending, drop pending or closed) | any | nothing |
| none | not applicable | nothing |
